rows.Benefits Description:.The calendar year: You may purchase the following medications and supplies prescribed by a physician from SilverScript network pharmacies or through the mail order program: • Drugs and medications (including those administered during a non- covered admission or in a non-covered facility) that by Federal law of the United States require a physician's prescription for their purchase, except those listed as Not covered. • Diabetic supplies limited to: - Disposable needles and syringes for the administration of covered medications • Drugs to treat gender dysphoria: such as Estradiol; Testosterone Notes: • This prescription drug plan offers a formulary which covers Part D drugs required by CMS and additional drug coverage as outlined below: - Non-Part D Supplemental Benefit including but not limited to: • Agents when used for the symptomatic relief of cough and colds. • Agents when used for weight loss (Prior Authorization applies) • Prescription vitamins and mineral products, except prenatal vitamins and fluoride preparations. • For access to our formulary, please visit: geha.com/Rx-Plan • Prior authorization may be required for certain drugs , call us at 833-250-3241 if you have any questions regarding preauthorization, quantity limits, or other issues.
rows.You pay.The calendar year deductible app: Retail pharmacy, up to a 30-day supply: • Generic (Preferred pharmacy): 20% of Plan allowance • Generic (Non-preferred pharmacy): 25% of Plan allowance • Preferred brand: 25% of Plan allowance • Non-preferred brand: 40% of Plan allowance Mail order pharmacy, up to 90-day supply: • Generic (Preferred pharmacy): 20% of Plan allowance • Generic (Non-preferred pharmacy): 25% of Plan allowance • Preferred brand (Preferred pharmacy): 25% of Plan allowance • Preferred brand (Non-preferred pharmacy): 25% of Plan allowance • Non-preferred brand (Preferred pharmacy): 40% of Plan allowance • Non-preferred brand (Non-preferred pharmacy): 40% of Plan allowance Specialty drugs, up to 30-day supply: • 25% of Plan allowance
